description: Applies ordered schema migrations, one transaction per migration step, from the database's current version up to target_version (or the latest known version if None).
signature: def migrate(conn: sqlite3.Connection, target_version: int | None = None) -> int
docstring:
Apply pending migrations in order.

Args:
    conn: An open connection.
    target_version: Version to migrate to. None means the latest version this codebase knows about.

Returns:
    The resulting schema version after all applicable migrations have run (equal to target_version on success).

Raises:
    StorageError: If target_version is lower than the current version (downgrade is unsupported), if target_version is higher than the latest known migration, or if any individual migration step fails (the failing step's transaction is rolled back, and prior successful steps in this call remain committed since each step is its own transaction).
preconditions: initialize_schema or a prior migrate call has already established a valid schema_meta row (migrate does not create the schema_meta table itself if entirely absent -- initialize_schema does)
postconditions: current_schema_version(conn) == the returned value after a successful call
All rows present before migration remain present and correctly typed after migration (no silent data loss for the columns that carry forward)

edge_cases.input: target_version equal to the current version
edge_cases.expected_behavior: no-op, returns the current version unchanged

edge_cases.input: target_version lower than the current version
target_version higher than the latest migration this code knows about
edge_cases.expected_behavior: StorageError naming the highest available version

edge_cases.input: A migration step raises partway through (e.g. a malformed ALTER TABLE on a fixture with unexpected legacy data)
edge_cases.expected_behavior: that step's transaction rolls back entirely; already-applied earlier steps in the same call remain committed; current_schema_version reflects the last successfully applied step, not the failed target

unit_tests.name: test_migrate_from_older_fixture_reaches_current_version
unit_tests.description: tests/fixtures/db_schema_v1.sqlite migrated to None (latest) ends at CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION and preserves all pre-existing rows.

unit_tests.name: test_downgrade_rejected
unit_tests.description: Migrating from version 2 to target_version=1 raises StorageError.

unit_tests.name: test_noop_when_already_at_target
unit_tests.description: Migrating to the current version is a no-op.
